component.name: Accio Launcher
component.summary: Download, install and launch the eight Harry Potter PC games
Télécharger, installer et lancer les huit jeux Harry Potter PC
Descargar, instalar y lanzar los ocho juegos de Harry Potter para PC

description.p: Accio Launcher downloads, installs and launches the eight Harry Potter PC games (2001-2011). On Linux, the games run through umu-launcher (Proton) or Wine installed on the system.
Accio Launcher télécharge, installe et lance les huit jeux Harry Potter PC (2001-2011). Sous Linux, les jeux tournent par umu-launcher (Proton) ou par le Wine du système.

screenshot.caption: The library: the eight games, one click to play
